result.topic_en: Calculations in linear elasticity theory: expressing the displacements u, w through repeated x-integrals of the normal stress N_1 and the shear stress T_2 and their Laplacians, and deriving relations between these stress components.
result.transcription:
[-$N_1 = \lambda\theta + 2\mu\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$-] $\quad T_2 = \mu\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial x}\right)$
[-...-] $\Delta^2 N_1 = 2\mu\cdot(\lambda+\mu)\Delta^2\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial x^2} = -2(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2\theta}{\partial x^2}$
$-2(\lambda+\mu)\theta = \iint \Delta^2 N_1 \partial x^2$
$2(\lambda+\mu)N_1 + \lambda\iint\Delta^2 N_1\partial x^2 = 4(\lambda+\mu)\mu\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$4(\lambda+\mu)\mu u = 2(\lambda+\mu)\int N_1\partial x + \lambda\int^3\partial x^3\Delta^2 N_1$
$4(\lambda+\mu)\mu W = 4(\lambda+\mu)\int T_2\partial x - 2(\lambda+\mu)\int^2\frac{\partial N_1}{\partial z}\partial x^2 - \lambda\int^4\partial x^4\frac{\partial\Delta^2 N_1}{\partial z}$
$x\int\Delta^2 N_1\partial x - 2N_1 = \alpha$
$x\int\Delta^2 N_1\partial x - \int^2\partial x^2\Delta^2 N_1 - 2N_1 = \beta$
$\int\left(\frac{\partial T_2}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial T_3}{\partial z}\right)\partial x = \gamma$
$\alpha - \beta = \int^2\partial x^2\Delta^2 N_1$
$2N_1 = x\left(\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial\beta}{\partial x}\right) - \alpha\ ,\quad \frac{\partial T_2}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial N_1}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial z} - \frac{\partial\beta}{\partial z}$
$\int\left(\frac{\partial T_2}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial T_3}{\partial y}\right)\partial x = -N_1$
$\int\frac{\partial^2 T_2}{\partial y^2} + \frac{\partial^2 T_2}{\partial z^2}\partial x = \frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial N_1}{\partial z}$
$\Delta^2\int\left(\frac{\partial^2 T_2}{\partial y^2} + \frac{\partial^2 T_2}{\partial z^2}\right)\partial x = -\frac{\partial\Delta^2 N_1}{\partial z} = -\frac{\partial\Delta^2 T_2}{\partial x}$
$\int^2\Delta^2 T_2\partial x^2 = \int\frac{\partial\Delta^2 N_1}{\partial z}\partial x^2$
$\frac{\partial T_2}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial N_1}{\partial z} + \int^2\frac{\partial\Delta^2 N_1}{\partial z}\partial x^2$

methods.what: Stress-strain relations of isotropic linear elasticity (Lamé constants)
Laplacian of normal stress expressed via second x-derivative of dilatation
Displacement u expressed by repeated x-integrals of N_1 and its Laplacian
Displacement w expressed via integrals of T_2 and N_1
